fields.name: syncToken
fields.description: Scratch: Google incremental-sync token from the last listEvents; in-memory per instance — a restart falls back to a full list.

fields.name: lastSyncedAt
fields.description: When the last full push+pull cycle completed; 0 = never.

fields.name: headId
fields.description: Scratch: id of the target row the push loop is currently exporting.

fields.name: pending
fields.description: Scratch: remote events remaining in the current pull-upsert loop.

fields.name: lastError
fields.description: Last sync failure detail; blank = none.

events.name: CAL_SYNCED
events.description: A full push+pull cycle completed; wire to std-notify-on-event or a status surface.

events.name: CAL_SYNC_FAILED
events.description: A calendar service call / fetch / persist failed — lastError carries the detail and the cycle stops until the next trigger.

events.name: PUSH_ROWS_LOADED
events.description: Target rows with a blank externalEventId marker — the remaining local→remote export queue.

events.name: CAL_EVENT_CREATED
events.description: calendar.createEvent result, flattened onto the payload by the call-service effect executor.

events.name: PUSH_STEPPED
events.description: Target row stamped with its new externalEventId; drives the next push pass.

events.name: CAL_REMOTE_LISTED
events.description: calendar.listEvents result — the remote change set for the pull-upsert loop.

events.name: PULL_TARGET_LOADED
events.description: CalendarEvent rows loaded for externalEventId matching in the pull-upsert.

events.name: PULL_STEPPED
events.description: One remote event upserted into the CalendarEvent store; drives the next pull pass.

events.name: PULL_NEXT
events.description: Pull loop control: how many remote events remain in the queue.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Calendar id
overridableConfigKeys.description: Google calendar to sync with; blank = the service's default (GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ID env, else primary).

overridableConfigKeys.label: Description field
overridableConfigKeys.description: Target-entity field holding the description/notes; blank = none.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Duration field
overridableConfigKeys.description: Target-entity field holding the per-row duration in minutes (e.g. ClassSession.durationMinutes). Takes precedence over the fixed `durationMinutes` when set; ignored when `endField` is set. Field precedence: endField > durationField > durationMinutes — the corpus carries all these event shapes.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: minutes field, length field, per-row duration

overridableConfigKeys.label: Duration (minutes)
overridableConfigKeys.description: Fixed event length used when both `endField` and `durationField` are blank; the calendar service computes the timezone-correct end.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Sync with Google Calendar
overridableConfigKeys.description: Push local records to Google Calendar and pull remote events into the CalendarEvent store. Off by default; needs the calendar service credentials (GOOGLE_CALENDAR_SA_KEY).
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: enable, calendar sync, google calendar, two-way sync, sync events, connect calendar

overridableConfigKeys.label: End field
overridableConfigKeys.description: Target-entity field holding the ISO end. Blank = derive the end from `durationMinutes` instead (the corpus carries all four event shapes).

overridableConfigKeys.label: Location field
overridableConfigKeys.description: Target-entity field holding the location; blank = none.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Start field
overridableConfigKeys.description: Target-entity field holding the ISO start (dateTime, or YYYY-MM-DD for all-day).
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: start date field, begins field, scheduledAt field

overridableConfigKeys.label: Entity to push
overridableConfigKeys.description: Event-shaped entity whose rows export to Google Calendar. MUST declare the marker columns `externalEventId : string = ""` and `syncedAt : number = 0` (stamped by the push loop). Defaults to the atom's own CalendarEvent store so the standalone validates; rebind per composition.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: entity to sync, source entity, record type, appointments entity, sessions entity

overridableConfigKeys.label: Title field
overridableConfigKeys.description: Target-entity field holding the event title.
